{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for internal test orders — revenue = '999999.99'
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue values with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Display a few examples
print("Examples with commas:")
print(df[has_commas]['revenue'].head(5))"}
